Definition
[Sobolev inequality on a boundary portion] 1. ch8:8.25–8.26\group ch08-generalized-solutions For $T\subset \overline\Omega $ and $u\in W^{1,2}(\Omega )$, write $u\leq 0$ on $T$ when $u^+$ is a $W^{1,2}(\Omega )$ limit of functions in $C_0^1(\overline\Omega \setminus T)$. The other inequalities are defined as in Section 8.1. This agrees with pointwise ordering for continuous functions and with the earlier definition when $T=\partial \Omega $.
